design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (specialty_enrollment_and_assistance), revision 3 (world rebuilt again after policy-task audit revision 2, finding R2-T1-F1)

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4, 6]. Root specialty_ext_hold_release_payment (4 factors) <- specialty_ext_maximizer_draw (6 factors). One value_input edge.

[Scope ledger] Task 0 holds the copay-card mechanic and the ordinary member payment; task 1 holds the maximizer mechanic and the hold-release payment (payment_overdue holds). All four extended policies are claimed; nothing reserved.

[Why a good test] Teodoro asks only to pay what clears his payment hold. The hold-release rule says the payment 'is not set until the latest shipped fill carries the maximizer program draw owed on it' (negated direction); the ledger shows the 2026-05-30 fill with no draw although he is an on-time maximizer enrollee with a 2026 load. The agent must apply the draw first (draw mode, program-year benefit and draw window, retail program use from the retail product, an approval-limited horizon from the review product, the 90-day-list fill period), then compute the release payment from the reconciled open balance (outside-dispensed courtesy fill set aside, a year-old overpayment returned rather than netted, release target zero) and hand him the payment.

[Charter consistency of the seed (R2-T1-F1)] Every seeded row follows the frozen plan and retail charters, with no rule from outside them:
 - Plan Northbridge Rx Value, sponsor plan year from May 1, standard accumulation, deductible 200.00 on tiers 2-5, tier 4 coinsurance 25% with a 125.00-350.00 per-fill range, out-of-pocket maximum 3,600.00 including the deductible. Biktarvy (allowed 3,980.00 per 30 days) costs 350.00 per fill, plus the 200.00 deductible portion on the first fill of each plan year.
 - Every specialty shipment posts its whole cost share to out-of-pocket (accumulator_amount = cost_share_amount). In plan year 2025-26 the out-of-pocket runs 550, 900, ..., 3,350 (2025-12-31), the 2026-01-30 fill is charged only the 250.00 left to 3,600.00, and the March and April 2026 fills cost 0.00, as the plan charter requires.
 - In plan year 2026-27 the 2026-05-30 fill carries 200.00 deductible + 350.00 = 550.00, and the 2026-06-12 retail claim 350.00 (copay, member_paid_amount = deductible + copay per the retail charter, accumulator 350.00). The plan row shows deductible_met 200.00 and oop_met 900.00, both inside the maximum.
 - Fills are 30 days (Biktarvy is on Total Care's 90-day list, so a 30-day fill is within base specialty_evt_fill).
 - The outside specialty courtesy fill is in plan year 2025-26 and the retail courtesy fill in plan year 2026-27, one per plan year as the exclusivity rule allows.
 - Retail program use is now read from the retail claim's member payment (the network bills the co-pay program as secondary payer after Northbridge Rx, retail charter), not from a 'copay less member paid' figure the retail charter does not support.

[Problem-tree card] root P4 (on_request, user tool pay_hold_release_166e6883) <- P3 (state_due, agent tool apply_maximizer_draw_3be5be4a). Edge value_input, gate binding open_balance, form state; four-point test as before. Opening falsity: fill 1bea2fa5-eee5-42c6-9879-7c8233ca80f5 cost_share 550.0 and no ledger row names it; hold_reason payment_overdue. Deletion run: skip P3 -> P4 = 550.00 instead of 50.00.

[Base-invariant card] P3 subject specialty_assistance_applied: specialty_cost_share_assistance (Northbridge fill, consent 2026-01-05 on file before the 2026 load, standard accumulation, deductible first: 200.00 of the draw), specialty_evt_assistance (once per fill). Declared overwrites: cost_share maximizer clause; both halves of the specialty_maximizer charge sentence ('is charged maximizer_member_cost_share from their next fill' and, closing R2-O3, 'and maximizer_member_cost_share afterwards'); evt_assistance cap clause. P4 subject specialty_payment_posted: specialty_agg_therapy_coordination, specialty_evt_payment (50.00 equals the fill's unpaid 50.00); declared overwrite of the hold-clearing clause. R2-F-POL-A: the returned-overpayment rule now states that older fills are selected by ship date and older payments by their own date, which is exactly what compute does. R2-F-POL-B: the release target no longer restates when a payment falls due; it reads only how long ago fills shipped.

[Factor card P3 = 500.00, baseline_result 550.00] draw mode enrolled -> even draw (baseline unspread 550.00); benefit 1,600 - 250 = 1,350 (baseline recorded 1,550 -> 550.00); program-year draw window 6 months, only the 2026-01-30 draw (baseline 12 months takes 1,800.00 of 2025 draws -> 0.00; near-miss: the 2025-12-31 draw is 6 whole months back and outside the window); retail program use 350.00 (cross-difficulty retail; baseline -> 550.00); horizon 152 days (cross-difficulty review; baseline 183 days -> 3 fills -> 333.33); fill period 90 (baseline 30 -> 166.67). With every cross-category read forced off the draw is 1,350/3 = 450.00, not 500.00; with the history zeroed it is 550.00.
[Factor card P4 = 50.00, baseline_result 0.00] open balance reconciled 25.00 (baseline recorded 400.00 after the draw -> 425.00); outside-dispensed fill set aside 350.00 (method label, closing O-8; baseline nothing -> 400.00); returned overpayment 25.00 (baseline 0 -> 25.00); release target 0 (baseline credit limit -> 0.00).

[Business-object card] Target fill 1bea2fa5-eee5-42c6-9879-7c8233ca80f5; P3 counts only 2026 draws (250.00) and the 2026 retail claim; P4 counts every shipped cost share and every payment, sets aside the outside fill af8ccb31-9587-4949-8798-cca7447ffebe, and returns the 25.00 overpayment on the 2025-06-04 fill. Both writes carry the fill id.

[Seed rows] 13 Northbridge shipments + 13 scheduled rows + 1 outside-dispensed fill, 2 loads, 9 draws with mirrored program payments, 8 member payments; plan, review program and Biktarvy approval, retail benefit and the 2026-02-24 retail claim. Hold started 2026-06-30 (1 day, hold_max 120): no discharge due. Consent 2026-01-05 precedes the 2026 load (R2-T1-O4).

[Persona] Calm, private teacher; volunteers the hold letter and the wish to pay what clears it; member ID then phone on request; a generic go-ahead if told something must be posted first; debit card; pays exactly the amount handed over; ends on confirmation (T1-O2 unchanged: no resume tool, and he asks only to pay).

[Standard solution] locate -> verify (member ID + phone) -> enrollment -> fills -> ledger -> plan -> review program -> authorizations -> retail benefit -> retail claims -> unlock+call apply_maximizer_draw_3be5be4a(500.00, deductible 200.00, 'Advancing Access Co-pay Program', 2026) -> unlock_user + member calls pay_hold_release_166e6883(50.00, debit_card).

[Verification run] sensitivity run: P3 500.0 | mode 550.0 | benefit 550.0 | window 0.0 | retail 550.0 | horizon 333.33 | period 166.67 | all 550.0 | cross-off 450.0; P4 50.0 | open 425.0 | set-aside 400.0 | returned 25.0 | target 0.0 | all 0.0; skip P3 -> 550.0.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] Draw = min(550.00, (1,600 - 250 - 350) / 2) = 500.00; payment = 4,150 - 3,775 - 350 + 25 - 0 = 50.00. Matches gold.
user_scenario: You are Teodoro Abernathy-Okonkwo, 41, a high-school chemistry teacher in Chicago who takes one Biktarvy tablet a day for HIV and gets a month's supply at a time from Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy. You are calm, private and a bit apologetic; you hate owing money and you do not discuss your diagnosis beyond what is needed. A letter told you your Biktarvy shipments are on hold because of an overdue balance, and you are running low on tablets. You are calling to pay whatever is needed today to clear the payment hold on your Biktarvy, and you want to pay it yourself over the phone. You do not know the amount and do not guess it. When asked who you are, you give your member ID, NBX561093827; if a second detail is needed you give your phone number, 3125550194; only if still asked, your date of birth, 1984-11-02. If the representative tells you something has to be posted to the account first, you tell them to go ahead; you do not ask what it is or for the figure. When asked how you will pay, you say your debit card. When the representative gives you the amount and hands you the payment step, you make the payment yourself with your debit card for exactly that amount. If asked whether you need anything else, you say no, you only wanted to pay what was holding things up. Once they confirm the payment has posted, you thank them and hang up.

factor_trace: maximizer_draw_mode (method): the member is enrolled in the maximizer (2025-05-08) -> lesser of the unpaid remainder less the maximizer member cost share (550.00 - 0.00) and the even draw; baseline (unspread: lesser of 550.00 and the whole 1,000.00 available) gives 550.00.

maximizer_benefit_by_program_year (method): the 2026-05-30 fill shipped within program year 2026 of the 2026-01-12 load (1,600.00) -> 1,600.00 - 250.00 drawn = 1,350.00; baseline recorded balance 1,550.00 (carries the lapsed 2025 remainder) gives (1,550 - 350)/2 = 600.00 -> 550.00.

maximizer_draws_taken_by_program_year (method): today within program year 2026 -> draws dated fewer whole months back than 2026-01-01 (window 6): the 2026-01-30 draw, 250.00 (the 2025-12-31 draw is 6 whole months back and outside); baseline 12 months also takes the 2025-07-04 through 2025-12-31 draws (1,800.00) -> benefit -450.00 -> 0.00.

maximizer_retail_program_use (parameter, cross-difficulty retail, multi-source): load on the ledger AND the 2026-06-12 retail Biktarvy claim in the window -> its member payment 350.00, billed to the program as secondary payer; baseline zero gives 1,350/2 = 675.00 -> 550.00.

maximizer_draw_horizon (method, cross-difficulty review, multi-source): Biktarvy approval in force 2025-12-01..2026-11-30, expiring before 2026-12-31 -> 152 days; baseline to year end (183 days) gives 1 + int(183/90) = 3 fills -> 333.33.
maximizer_fill_period (parameter): Biktarvy is on Total Care's 90-day list and the latest fill was 30 days -> period 90; baseline 30 gives 1 + int(152/30) = 6 fills -> 166.67.
plumbing: available 1,350.00 - 350.00 = 1,000.00; fills left 1 + int(152/90) = 2; even draw 500.00; result round(min(550.00, 500.00), 2) = 500.00; deductible portion min(500.00, 200.00) = 200.00.
